column1: # The k-mer copy threshold sweep behind MIN_KMER_COPIES, MAX_KMER_COPIES and DEPTH_PER_KMER_COPY
# in brucellaid/mash.py. Each row is one real library at one depth measured at one threshold:
# how many of the reference sketch's 1000 min-hashes the reads shared with the genome they match.
# source "subsample": one of three of the four tutorial libraries, strided down to that depth,
#   Striding one library separates depth from library quality, which comparing libraries cannot.
# source "ena": one of 60 public runs stratified across the depth range, swept at its own depth to 64.
#   The tutorial libraries stop at 70x and the median public Brucella run is 141x.
# scripts/make_kmer_figure.py draws assets/kmer_threshold.svg from this file.
